title: The Machine Wanders On
description: The running light continues past the strongroom into a
passage the vault does not admit to having, and the
ticking changes pitch. Down here, that is an invitation.
The resonant halls are next: geode country, where the
air rings and every footstep is Somebody Else's
Problem. The machine's light follows as far as the
crystal and then, for the first time in its long
Six stations, the same six, ringing.
Leave the wire the way you found it. It knows where it
is going even if you do not.
